Definition: Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Onam was an Edomite, a son of Shobal, named among the dukes of the Horites in the genealogy of Seir. He was a son of Shobal, and his brother was Ebal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Onam is one of the sons of Seir, and his name in the genealogy shows that God recorded the Horites as carefully as He recorded Israel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
